up: Retrieve all distinct molecules that are associated with the document identified by ChEMBL ID CHEMBL1123558. The document is in the docs table. Molecules are linked to the document through the compound_records table (via doc_id). Use the molecule_dictionary table to get the chembl_id and pref_name (as compound_name) for each molecule. Use the compound_structures table to get canonical_smiles. Only include molecules where canonical_smiles is not null. Order the results by chembl_id, compound_name, and canonical_smiles.
sql:
SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id, md.pref_name AS compound_name, cs.canonical_smiles
FROM docs d
JOIN compound_records cr ON d.doc_id = cr.doc_id
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON cr.molregno = md.molregno
JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno
WHERE d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1123558'
  AND cs.canonical_smiles IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY md.chembl_id, compound_name, cs.canonical_smiles;
